purpose: Sanitized root control manifest. It is intentionally safe for clean exploration workers to read because substantive O/downstream semantics are not co-located here. Revision 16 adds a sanitized Phase-1 assignment overlay for the physically active CLEAN pool without exposing O or other-worker semantics.

config_resolution.resolution_rule: After reading this root manifest, resolve only the config destination appropriate to the current bootstrap role. Clean exploration workers must read only their own role-local config path and must never read DOWNSTREAM_STATE.json, O_OPERATIONS.json, another role config, another receipt namespace, or the shared aggregate ledger. While phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.active=true, a listed CLEAN role MUST apply only its own sanitized overlay entry as the current additive assignment before its base role objective; the overlay may change source focus/method/expected output but never weakens the role-local safety, evidence, continuation, anti-stop, checkpoint/resume, retry/backoff, recovery or clean-boundary contract. Non-exploration managed roles resolve their exact role entry from DOWNSTREAM_STATE.json. O operations roles continue to resolve from O_OPERATIONS.json.

global_safe_policy.control_freshness: At run start obtain the latest note main object SHA using a SHA-only Git-ref lookup such as refs/heads/main or an equivalent response that contains no commit message, diff, file snippet, other-role receipt text, or other semantic payload. Fetch this manifest plus the role's designated config at that exact SHA. Before the first substantive semantic read, repeat the SHA-only ref lookup; if control_revision or the role config_revision changed, refetch and restart the pre-semantic bootstrap on the newer tuple. The first role-local/public-source semantic read is a hard semantic-freeze barrier: from that point the selected {main SHA, control revision, config revision, config blob} is immutable for the physical invocation. If control changes after the barrier, do not adopt it, reinterpret results, or continue semantic work under it; checkpoint under the frozen tuple and defer the newer control to the next invocation. If a connector unexpectedly bundles semantic text with a head lookup, quarantine and discard that text before reasoning and use a clean SHA-only ref lookup instead.
global_safe_policy.receipt_chronology: Durable receipts must use actual observed offset-aware timestamps, not rounded filename labels, for invocation_started_at/started_at and checkpointed_at/ended_at/receipt_written_at. Any terminal receipt timestamp must be greater than or equal to the invocation start timestamp. If exact chronology cannot be established, preserve the raw observations and mark chronology_valid=false; never fabricate or backdate a terminal timestamp.
global_safe_policy.connector_discovery_read_only: Capability/schema/tool discovery is observation-only. Never create, update, delete, move, or otherwise mutate repository refs, branches, files, pull requests, issues, releases, workflows, external resources, or account state merely to test whether a connector capability exists. Use schema/list/discovery functions and read-only lookups. A managed role may mutate only the exact destinations explicitly authorized by its frozen role config for substantive role work, with the required CAS/readback discipline; temporary/noop probe mutations are forbidden. If any role records a connector-discovery mutation incident, that role must carry an equivalent explicit role-local read-only discovery/write-boundary guard before its next substantive invocation; the root guard alone is not sufficient evidence of executed enforcement.
global_safe_policy.recurring_scheduler_persistence: For repository-enabled recurring managed roles, one invocation ending, checkpointing, finding no new evidence, hitting a response/runtime boundary, or stopping semantic work on post-freeze head drift is never successful completion of the recurring objective. A role with enabled_desired=true must not request, perform, or imply platform scheduler disable/delete on that basis. Physical scheduler state is controlled separately; only an explicit user stop, a repository enabled_desired=false decision reconciled by the authorized controller, or a deliberate measured topology reallocation may justify physical disablement.

semantic_inputs_forbidden: other clean-worker state or role config
commit messages/diffs/file snippets or other semantic payload obtained only while resolving repository head SHA
clean_exploration_boundary.receipt_rule: write only immutable role-local receipts without reading shared or other-role observability content; each receipt must identify exactly one frozen semantic control/config tuple for the invocation, include the current Phase-1 assignment task_id when an overlay applies, and satisfy global_safe_policy.receipt_chronology
clean_exploration_boundary.feedback_rule: own sanitized feedback is mechanical self-local quality control only and cannot convey novelty, relevance, acceptance/rejection, ranking, preferred mechanisms, O knowledge, or other-worker information
clean_exploration_boundary.own_state_resolution: Use role-local LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology and minimum predecessor chain. Quarantine accidentally opened stale/cross-role observability content and do not use it semantically.
clean_exploration_boundary.scope_guard: never broaden positive or negative evidence beyond tested scope
clean_exploration_boundary.head_lookup_transport: For cleanliness/freshness checks use Git ref object lookup only. Do not use generic commit search, commit detail, branch detail, repository search, or any endpoint/tool response that may bundle unrelated commit messages, diffs, file snippets, or receipt bodies merely to learn the head SHA.
clean_exploration_boundary.connector_mutation_boundary: Connector discovery and capability probing must be read-only. Clean roles may write only their own role-local state/output namespace and immutable own receipt namespace when substantive role work requires it; creating temporary/noop branches, refs, PRs, issues, files outside those namespaces, or other probe side effects is prohibited.

phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.sanitization: This overlay contains only generic process/mechanism objectives. It carries no O state, O-derived priorities, downstream judgments, other-worker outputs, acceptance/rejection labels or cross-worker semantic information.
phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.assignment_precedence: For listed roles, this sanitized assignment is the current substantive objective during Phase 1. The role-local pre-existing substantive objective and exact continuation remain preserved as fallback/restoration metadata and must NOT resume merely because this assignment completes, blocks, or looks low-value.
phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.completion_reassignment: On completing or blocking an assignment, checkpoint it and continue with the next generic unresolved Phase-1 leaf or transversal candidate within the same role's allowed public-source/own-state domain. Do not restore base work until Phase 1 ends or optimizer control cannot safely continue.
phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.base_contract_non_regression: All role-local CLEAN isolation, anti-stop, continuation, checkpoint/resume, recovery, retry/backoff, evidence/provenance, exact-scope and scheduler-persistence clauses remain mandatory.

neuroscience.objective: Audit public mechanisms for robust latest-state reconstruction under partial observation, stale caches, memory/state mismatch and bounded-context execution. Produce generic mechanism/failure evidence only; do not read or infer O/downstream/other-worker state.
neuroscience.method: existing-solution audit first; direct mechanism synthesis second; compare freshness proof, state versioning, checkpoint lineage, idempotent readback and uncertainty handling; use public sources plus own prior clean state only
neuroscience.expected_output: role-local source-qualified checkpoint plus receipt separating observations, inference and unverified claims, with exact tested scope and candidate mechanisms for reconstructing current state safely

long_horizon.objective: Audit generic scheduled-run continuity, checkpoint/resume and recovery contracts that preserve an unfinished parent objective across hard runtime boundaries without false completion.
long_horizon.method: existing-solution audit; analyze durable continuation identifiers, replay safety, restart semantics, bounded rechecks, overrun/reforecast triggers and recovery without duplicate effects
long_horizon.expected_output: role-local evidence for continuation/recovery acceptance tests and failure cases under recurring Chat-mode runs

self_improvement.objective: Audit generic optimizer policies for forecast/reforecast, transversal candidate generation, alternative-plan switching and crash-safe evaluation when progress overruns expectations.
self_improvement.method: compare direct-vs-decompose decision rules, expected-time/success estimates, switching thresholds, evidence preservation and no-regression restoration metadata
self_improvement.expected_output: role-local candidate control policies and measurable switching/forecast criteria

open_source.objective: Audit public repositories/frameworks for orchestration, CAS/idempotency, checkpointing, claims, exact readback and branch/PR preparation that are executable with ordinary Chat-mode repository/tool surfaces.
open_source.method: prefer official repositories/docs; verify concrete APIs/artifacts; distinguish Chat-capable direct operations from unavailable/background/primary-writer-only actions
open_source.expected_output: role-local implementation-pattern matrix with exact source/version and capability boundary

failure_evidence.objective: Find and classify generic failure evidence for stale-state reconstruction, duplicate effects, false completion, unsafe handoff, hidden background assumptions, conflicting claims and non-idempotent retry.
failure_evidence.method: negative-evidence-first search; preserve counterexample scope; map failure trigger -> detectable signal -> fail-closed response -> recovery evidence
failure_evidence.expected_output: role-local failure/counterexample matrix usable for Phase-1 acceptance testing without O-specific semantics

reasoning.objective: Develop a generic deterministic architecture for latest-state reconstruction, non-conflicting task selection, direct-solution-first reasoning, decomposition only when unresolved, durable continuation and precise exclusive-action handoff.
reasoning.method: direct solution first; audit existing approaches before decomposition; explicitly prove invariants and generate transversal alternatives when branch count exceeds forecast
reasoning.expected_output: role-local architecture and proof obligations for the generic Chat-parity root

evaluation.objective: Define measurable generic acceptance tests for freshness, useful-output rate, duplication, persistence, conflict avoidance, recovery, handoff precision and unsupported-completion rejection in recurring Chat-capable workers.
evaluation.method: precommit metrics and pass/fail criteria; distinguish coverage from success; include adversarial and missing-capability cases
evaluation.expected_output: role-local executable/inspectable evaluation matrix and stopping criterion that does not depend on O semantics

multi_agent.objective: Audit generic multi-worker concurrency/claim/decomposition methods that avoid duplicate work and write conflicts without assuming hidden background subagents.
multi_agent.method: public-source audit plus own state; compare claim granularity, reservation, stale-claim recovery, parent/child integration and sequential-vs-parallel switch rules
multi_agent.expected_output: role-local concurrency/claim protocol candidates and failure tests

scientist_agents.objective: Audit generic reproducible agent-lifecycle patterns for durable evidence, provenance, continuation, verification and handoff of only irreducible exclusive actions.
scientist_agents.method: separate research claim from executable artifact; require source-qualified evidence and reproducibility hooks; preserve abandoned-branch evidence
scientist_agents.expected_output: role-local lifecycle/handoff protocol evidence and reproducibility criteria

migration.reason: The Phase-1 optimizer control previously depended on dedicated canaries that are not part of the currently executing pool, while currently active CLEAN roles continued their base research. Revision 16 adds a sanitized active-pool Phase-1 overlay so every executing CLEAN role contributes to the same generic parity root without O/downstream/other-worker semantic leakage and without changing physical scheduler state.
migration.rollback: Restore DESIRED_STATE blob f8637800721d29b4f293ed2ed52aebdda4983931 only if the sanitized overlay prevents a listed CLEAN role from safely checkpointing or violates the clean-exploration boundary. Preserve all revision-15 freshness, chronology, connector read-only, scheduler-persistence and exact-scope safeguards on rollback. Never restore base work merely because one Phase-1 leaf completes.
